articles.title: Meta Launches Ray-Ban Blayzer and Scriber — Prescription Smart Glasses at $499
articles.excerpt: Meta launched the Blayzer and Scriber, its first Ray-Ban smart glasses built for prescription wearers. Starting at $499, pre-order now, ships April 14.

articles.title: OpenAI Closes a $122 Billion Funding Round. IPO Is Next.
articles.excerpt: OpenAI closed a $122B round at an $852B valuation — the largest startup raise in Silicon Valley history. An IPO and a unified AI superapp are next.

articles.title: Bethesda Is Shutting Down The Elder Scrolls: Blades on June 30
articles.excerpt: Bethesda is pulling the plug on The Elder Scrolls: Blades on June 30. The mobile spinoff has been delisted from all stores, and everything in-game is now free until shutdown.

articles.title: Starcloud Raises $170M to Build Data Centers in Orbit. It Hit Unicorn in 17 Months.
articles.excerpt: Starcloud hit unicorn status 17 months after YC demo day, raising $170M to build compute infrastructure in orbit. First satellite already carries an Nvidia H100 GPU.

articles.title: Sony Raises PS5 Prices Again. The PS5 Pro Now Costs $900.
articles.excerpt: Sony is raising PS5 prices globally starting April 2. The PS5 Pro jumps $150 to $900, the standard PS5 hits $650. Sony blames continued global economic pressures.

articles.title: China Bars Manus AI Founders from Leaving as Meta's $2B Acquisition Goes Under Review
articles.excerpt: China blocked Manus CEO Xiao Hong and chief scientist Ji Yichao from leaving the country while regulators review Meta's $2B acquisition of the AI startup.

articles.title: All 11 of xAI's Original Co-Founders Have Now Left the Company
articles.excerpt: Manuel Kroiss and Ross Nordeen, the last remaining co-founders, have left xAI. All 11 original co-founders are now gone as Musk rebuilds the company under SpaceX.

articles.title: Apple Kills the Mac Pro. No Replacement Is Coming.
articles.excerpt: Apple confirms the Mac Pro is dead with no future models planned. The Mac Studio takes over as Apple's high-end desktop.

articles.title: Tencent Brings AI Agent to WeChat, Giving 1 Billion Users Access to ClawBot
articles.excerpt: Tencent launched ClawBot, integrating the OpenClaw AI agent directly into WeChat for over 1 billion users. The move deepens the AI agent race among Chinese tech giants.

articles.title: Cursor Confirms Its New Composer 2 Model Is Built on Moonshot AI's Kimi
articles.excerpt: Cursor's new Composer 2 model turns out to be built on Chinese AI lab Moonshot's open-source Kimi 2.5. The $29B company admitted it should have credited the base model from the start.

articles.title: Apple Unveils MacBook Air with M5: More Power, Double the Storage
articles.excerpt: Apple announces MacBook Air with M5 chip, doubling base storage to 512GB and adding Wi-Fi 7 via the new N1 chip.

articles.title: Meta's AI Agent Went Rogue and Leaked Sensitive Data to Employees
articles.excerpt: An AI agent on Meta's internal forum gave an engineer advice that exposed a large amount of sensitive user and company data to employees for two hours. The incident triggered a major security alert and highlights the risks of deploying agentic AI at scale.

articles.title: Nvidia GTC 2026: Jensen Huang Projects $1 Trillion in Orders, Unveils Vera Rubin and Teases Feynman
articles.excerpt: At GTC 2026, Jensen Huang said Nvidia expects $1 trillion in purchase orders through 2027 between Blackwell and Vera Rubin. He unveiled the full Vera Rubin platform, the Groq 3 LPU from its $20B acquisition, and teased the next-gen Feynman architecture for 2028.

articles.title: Apple Launches the $599 MacBook Neo, Its Cheapest Laptop Ever
articles.excerpt: Apple unveiled the MacBook Neo, a $599 laptop powered by the A18 Pro chip. It comes in four colors, runs full macOS, lasts 16 hours on a charge, and handles on-device AI workloads up to 3x faster than Intel-based PCs. The cheapest Mac ever made.

articles.title: ChatGPT Can Now Order Food, Book Rides, and Create Playlists Inside Third-Party Apps
articles.excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT now connects to Spotify, DoorDash, Uber, Figma, Booking.com, and more. You can execute real actions inside these apps directly from a chat prompt. This is the agentic AI moment actually shipping to consumers.

articles.title: Meta Planning Sweeping Layoffs That Could Hit 20% of Its Workforce
articles.excerpt: Meta is reportedly considering major layoffs affecting up to 20% of the company as AI infrastructure costs mount. The cuts would help offset aggressive spending on AI while critics call it another case of AI-washing.

articles.title: Atlassian Cuts 1,600 Jobs as It Restructures Around AI
articles.excerpt: Atlassian is laying off roughly 10% of its workforce and replacing its CTO as it pivots to AI and enterprise sales. The move follows similar cuts at Block and WiseTech, signaling a broader trend of enterprise software companies reshaping their orgs around AI.

articles.title: Yann LeCun Leaves Meta, Raises $1 Billion for World Models Startup AMI Labs
articles.excerpt: Turing Prize winner Yann LeCun cofounded AMI Labs after leaving Meta, and the startup just closed a $1.03 billion round at a $3.5 billion valuation. The company is betting that AI needs to understand reality, not just language.

articles.title: Netflix Acquires Ben Affleck's AI Filmmaking Startup InterPositive
articles.excerpt: Netflix bought the 16-person AI startup founded by Ben Affleck in 2022. Unlike generative video tools, InterPositive builds custom AI models from a production's own footage to help filmmakers with color, lighting, and VFX in post.

articles.title: Google Hands Sundar Pichai a $692 Million Pay Package Tied to Waymo and Wing
articles.excerpt: Alphabet structured a three-year deal for its CEO that could make him one of the highest-paid executives on the planet. Most of it is performance-based, with new stock incentives linked to Waymo and Wing.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia Is Done Investing in OpenAI and Anthropic
articles.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company investments in OpenAI and Anthropic are likely its last, citing upcoming IPOs. But the real story may be the growing rift between the two AI labs and the circular economics of these deals.

articles.title: GPT-5.3 Instant Aims to Make ChatGPT Less Preachy and More Useful
articles.excerpt: OpenAI released GPT-5.3 Instant with fewer unnecessary refusals, reduced hallucinations, and a tone that is less "cringe." The update focuses on conversational quality over benchmark scores.

articles.title: Nvidia Pours $4 Billion Into Photonics as AI Hits a Data Transfer Wall
articles.excerpt: Nvidia is investing $2 billion each in Lumentum and Coherent to develop silicon photonics for next-generation AI data centers, signaling that moving data between chips is becoming the next big bottleneck.

articles.title: OpenAI Admits Pentagon Deal Was Rushed as Details of Agreement Emerge
articles.excerpt: Sam Altman acknowledged the controversial defense partnership was "definitely rushed" while OpenAI published its safeguards against autonomous weapons and mass surveillance.

articles.title: The Trap Anthropic Built for Itself
articles.excerpt: The Trump administration blacklisted Anthropic from the Pentagon after Dario Amodei refused to allow Claude for mass surveillance and autonomous kill-chain drones. Anthropic is challenging it in court.

articles.title: One Substack Post Just Crashed the Stock Market
articles.excerpt: A 33-year-old researcher published a speculative AI doomsday scenario on Substack. By Monday, the S&P had dropped over 1% and companies named in the report lost up to 6%.

articles.title: DeepSeek Trained Its Latest Model on Banned Nvidia Blackwell Chips
articles.excerpt: A senior Trump administration official confirms DeepSeek used Nvidia Blackwell GPUs to train its next model, likely violating U.S. export controls.

articles.title: 17 US AI Startups Have Raised $100M+ Each in Less Than Two Months
articles.excerpt: From Anthropic $30B Series G to ElevenLabs $500M round, the AI mega-funding pace in 2026 is already outpacing last year.

articles.title: NASA Perseverance Completes First AI-Planned Drive on Mars
articles.excerpt: NASA's Perseverance rover made history by navigating Mars using routes planned entirely by AI, powered by Anthropic's Claude models.

articles.title: Nvidia Nears $30 Billion Investment in OpenAI, Deepening Its Biggest Customer Bet
articles.excerpt: Nvidia is close to finalizing a $30 billion stake in OpenAI as part of a funding round that could value the AI startup at $730 billion.

articles.title: OpenAI Accuses DeepSeek of Distilling Its Models to Train Rival AI
articles.excerpt: OpenAI has formally asked U.S. lawmakers to act after alleging that DeepSeek systematically extracted ChatGPT outputs to train its own models.

articles.title: Unity Bets Big on AI: Full Casual Games from Text Prompts by March
articles.excerpt: Unity CEO says a new AI beta launching at GDC will let developers create entire casual games using natural language — no coding required.

articles.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6: Anthropic Makes Its Mid-Tier Model the New Default
articles.excerpt: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 4.6 as its new default for Pro and Team users — closing the gap with Opus at a fraction of the cost.

articles.title: Microsoft's Project Silica: Data Storage Set in Glass for 10,000 Years
articles.excerpt: Microsoft Research unveils Project Silica, a groundbreaking data storage solution using glass, promising millennia of data preservation.

articles.title: Google Gemini Unleashes Lyria 3: AI Music for the Masses
articles.excerpt: Google's latest AI music model, Lyria 3, lands in Gemini, opening up AI-powered music creation to a wider audience. Expect instant tunes and AI-generated album art.
